customManagers.description: The tool versions pinned by ARG lines in the Dockerfile. Those from apt repos also name the repo, as the deb datasource needs.

description: kubectl stays within one minor of the cluster it talks to, so only
its patches are proposed. Move to the next minor by hand when the
A Claude Code release is a new image, and rolling one out restarts the
pod running it, so bumps come at most once a week (Mondays, UTC).
